purpose: A02 examples distinguish documentary/design statements from exact observed local functions. This is not an implemented organization's acceptance record.

requirements.text: The fictional tenant should regain emergency administration within 30 minutes.
acceptance: Actual authorized two-account sign-in and alert timing within the stated bound.
unknowns: No Entra lab or sign-in exercise is authorized.

requirements.text: The supplied LocalSiteFixture denies the string plc.write for a valid synthetic operator credential.
acceptance: Local model returns allowed=false for exactly this input.

requirements.text: Determine whether the fictional EU workload requires exclusive local cryptographic authority.
acceptance: Explicit signed dimensional legal/service requirement determination.
unknowns: No real legal requirement or service/key coverage determination was supplied.

requirements.text: The intentionally altered in-memory log copy still has valid hash linkage.
acceptance: For this deliberately false assertion, valid linkage would return true; the actual observed false demonstrates failure of the assertion, while the tamper-detection test passes.
